title: Rogers' egg craft resembles Lazar's sport model

tellings.quote: out as I've described with this egg. It would be very much like his sports model.

plain: An egg-shaped craft that Greg Rogers, a doctor who worked with NASA, says he saw in a secret hangar looked very much like the "sport model." That is the name Bob Lazar, a man who says he worked on alien craft at a secret Nevada site called S-4 near Area 51, gave to a saucer he describes. Rogers makes the comparison himself on the show, saying the craft he describes "would be very much like his sports model." If true, it would mean two people separately saw the same kind of craft.
